intent.goal: Remove documentation barriers to understanding and adopting gh-aw using Claude Code without Copilot.
intent.acceptance: A source-defined concrete Copilot-free Claude setup/auth barrier is demonstrated in original before content and independently resolved in original after content with correctly specified Claude engine selection and required secret setup, verified against contemporaneous immutable implementation or standards. Merely mentioning Claude or increasing example counts is not a repair.

evidence.opportunity: Immutable before/after change to README.md or the six core documentation paths enumerated by doc-reader.
filters: A source-defined concrete Copilot-free Claude setup/auth barrier is demonstrated in original before content and independently resolved in original after content with correctly specified Claude engine selection and required secret setup, verified against contemporaneous immutable implementation or standards. Merely mentioning Claude or increasing example counts is not a repair.

evidence.collection: Offline original Git custody and complete production issue/PR discovery. Bounded candidate cohort; missing originals and Discussions remain gaps, not zero delivery.

definition.fullAcceptance: Copilot-free onboarding is followable, engine and tool classification accurate, prerequisites and authentication complete, and cited severity-specific barriers resolved without incorrect instructions.
limitations: Unknown facts score null, not zero. A bounded accepted case is partial coverage, not a complete repository-period population.

Workflow publishes Discussions. Issue/PR inventory does not establish Discussion discovery or zero workflow contributions.
